# Codex transcript provenance

`idle.jsonl` is a redacted copy of the `response_item/message/user` record at
line 9 of
`~/.partyline/sessions/codex/<attachment-id>/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl`.
`queued.jsonl` is a redacted copy of the `event_msg/item_completed/UserMessage`
record at line 33 in the same rollout. Message bodies and rollout metadata
were removed; source paste IDs and reader-relevant fields remain.
